entries.english: Go to her.
It's an absolute mess in here. (THUD)
You should stop and talk to both of them.
Please note that your call may be monitored.
(Click! Beep-beep-beep...)
I come here to practice my comedy routine and build up my confidence.
entries.fr: Je viens répéter mes blagues ici pour prendre confiance en moi.

entries.english: Would you like to hear a joke?
(I escaped from the pet store to explain the shop windows to you...)
entries.fr: (Je me suis enfui de l'animalerie pour t'expliquer les vitrines...)

entries.english: (Sometimes while shopping, you may notice that the window begins to flash.)
entries.fr: (En faisant tes achats, tu verras parfois la fenêtre clignoter.)

entries.english: (This means that the selected item is STRONGER than your current equipment.)
entries.fr: (L'objet choisi est alors PLUS FORT que ton équipement actuel.)

entries.english: (No flash means the item is the same or weaker than your current equipment.)
entries.fr: (Sans flash, l'objet est aussi fort ou plus faible que ton équipement.)

entries.english: (If the window turns black then the item cannot be equipped by that person.)
entries.fr: (Si la fenêtre devient noire, ce personnage ne peut pas équiper cet objet.)

entries.english: (There now. Was that helpful?)
(You already understand how to get an advantage in battle.)
entries.fr: (Tu sais déjà comment prendre l'avantage au combat.)

entries.english: (If you sneak up behind the enemy then the swirly swirl will be green.)
entries.fr: (Si tu surprends l'ennemi par derrière, la spirale sera verte.)

entries.english: (That means you'll get an extra turn at the start of the battle.)
entries.fr: (Tu auras alors un tour de plus au début du combat.)

entries.english: (Look out though!)
(Then they get an opening attack on you!)
(You should always try to have the advantage when fighting.)
entries.fr: (Essaie toujours de prendre l'avantage au combat.)

entries.english: (If you see a scary ghost or zombie you can run!)
entries.fr: (Si un fantôme ou un zombie te fait peur, cours!)

entries.english: (Just hold the Y button while moving around.)
(If you've already been running around a lot, you've most definitely gotten tired.)
entries.fr: (Si tu as déjà beaucoup couru, tu es sûrement fatigué.)

entries.english: (This is because you have limited stamina, so run sparrowingly.)
entries.fr: (Ton endurance est limitée, alors ne cours pas trop.)

entries.english: (Running away from monsters for too long would be a nasty scenario.)
entries.fr: (Fuir les monstres trop longtemps peut très mal finir.)

entries.english: Have you ever been in combat and taken a BIG hit you thought would K.O. you?
entries.fr: En combat, as-tu déjà reçu un gros coup qui aurait dû te mettre K.O.?

entries.english: But it didn't!
Instead, you toughed it out and won with only 1HP?
entries.fr: Tu as tenu bon et gagné avec un seul PV?

entries.english: That's FIGHTing spirit, baby!
The more FIGHT you have in you, the more likely you are to survive!
entries.fr: Plus tu as de COMBAT, plus tu as de chances de survivre!

entries.english: (I am a train loving mouse!)
(Before you buy a train ticket, you should take a look at the map on this sign.)
entries.fr: (Avant d'acheter un billet, regarde le plan sur ce panneau.)

entries.english: (Was that helpful?)
(I don't think it's strange for a mouse to love trains.)
entries.fr: (Une souris qui aime les trains, ce n'est pas étrange.)

entries.english: But you have no room.
Your mother wants to see you.
It's so cool, and you're the only one clever enough to help me put it together.
entries.fr: C'est génial! Tu es le seul assez malin pour m'aider à l'assembler.

entries.english: I wouldn't have expected a kid like you to give me the time of day!
entries.fr: Je ne pensais pas qu'un enfant comme toi daignerait m'écouter!

entries.english: I'll repair those torn tracks before the servicemen do.
entries.fr: Je réparerai ces rails avant les ouvriers.

entries.english: We're in business now!
Did you bring any mushrooms I can use?
Here, let me get that for you!
But none of the mushrooms were ready for picking.
All those cars and their exhaust are really killing my asthma!
entries.fr: Toutes ces voitures et leurs gaz aggravent mon asthme!

entries.english: You should steer clear unless you have a death wish.
entries.fr: Évite cet endroit, sauf si tu veux mourir.

entries.english: If you're crazy enough to try, pack as much gear as you can.
entries.fr: Si tu es assez fou pour essayer, prends plein d'équipement.

entries.english: Then recruit the toughest guy in town.
entries.fr: Puis recrute le plus costaud du coin.

entries.english: This mansion is gonna be your grave...
Sleep tight...
And don't let the bed bugs bite.
I'm the most upbeat person here in Spookane.
entries.fr: Je suis le plus joyeux de Spookane.

entries.english: I'm more like a game assistant than a resident of this town.
entries.fr: Je suis plutôt un assistant de jeu qu'un habitant d'ici.

entries.english: Surely there are things you've forgotten to jot down notes about, right?
entries.fr: Tu as sûrement oublié de prendre des notes sur certaines choses, non?

entries.english: I can give you a hint for only $1,000.
Discover the rest yourself.
Here is my first hint:
Here is my second hint:
An old lady at Reindeer Station has something important for you...
entries.fr: Une vieille dame à la gare de Reindeer a quelque chose pour toi...

entries.english: This is my final hint.
No matter how much it hurts your ears...
entries.fr: Même si ça te casse les oreilles...

entries.english: Look for the guitar player in Magicant...
Why, I could just gaze at you forever...
entries.fr: Je pourrais te contempler sans fin...

entries.english: If anyone can turn our mansion back to normal, I'm sure it's you.
entries.fr: Si quelqu'un peut rendre ce manoir normal, c'est bien toi.

entries.english: Here. This is the key to get in. (Tee hee)
entries.fr: Tiens, la clé pour entrer. (Hi hi)

entries.english: Oh, sorry, I was talking to my son, not you.
entries.fr: Pardon, je parlais à mon fils, pas à toi.

entries.english: Right.  Isn't that right?  That's right.
entries.fr: Oui. Pas vrai? C'est bien ça.

entries.english: Just leave me alone,
(He'll never know what I'm thinking...)
entries.fr: (Il ne saura jamais ce que je pense...)

entries.english: You can have as much as you like,
I beg you to learn it, and sing it to me...
entries.fr: Apprends-la et chante-la-moi, je t'en prie.

entries.english: Queen Mary vanished with a rush of wind.
As she faded away, so did Magicant.
Magicant was a mirage...
And then she starts to sing...
entries.fr: Puis elle se met à chanter...

entries.english: Only a little bit.
Then she forgets the tune,
It dwells within the earth, sea, and stars.
entries.fr: Elle est dans la terre, la mer, les astres.

entries.english: Have you heard of a Magic Candy that gives strength and power to a helpless child?
entries.fr: Connais-tu le Bonbon magique donnant force et puissance à un enfant sans défense?

entries.english: A boy with glasses could surely use one,
entries.fr: Un garçon à lunettes en aurait besoin,

entries.english: You seem quite helpless,
The boy with glasses could surely use one.
entries.fr: Le garçon à lunettes en aurait besoin.

entries.english: I am the Mysterious Mimicker.
Uh, just talk to me again if you want it back.
entries.fr: Reparle-moi si tu veux le récupérer.

entries.english: It looks...
Here you go...
Come back for it later.
but it won't fit!
Come back for it later.
Come get it later, then. Don't forget!
But neither will unhappiness.
So if you don't want trouble in your life...
entries.fr: Si tu veux une vie sans ennuis...

entries.english: I see...
Oh, a traveller!
Why don't you enjoy a meal at our house?
What are you staring at?
Here in Magicant it's just like the world outside.
Please fix it right away.
Promise me you'll come again!
Did you have a good night's rest?
Have you ever met the man who philosophizes about happiness?
entries.fr: As-tu rencontré l'homme qui philosophe sur le bonheur?

entries.english: You can use it to play any melodies you've learned.
entries.fr: Il permet de jouer les mélodies que tu as apprises.

entries.english: Do you want it?
You're a real straightforward dude, here you go.
entries.fr: Tu es quelqu'un de très direct. Tiens donc.

entries.english: It's quite obvious that you want it.
entries.fr: Il est évident que tu le veux.

entries.english: My heart is still pounding so hard.
entries.fr: Mon coeur bat encore très fort.

entries.english: Of course I am a non-singing monkey.
entries.fr: Je suis un singe qui ne chante pas.

entries.english: Normal monkeys don't sing.
You know...
I wonder why?
Now here it is.
This Magic Ribbon will give magical girls strength...
entries.fr: Ce Ruban magique renforce les filles magiques...

entries.english: I can't even think.
I should have known...
The story I will tell you is a real secret.
entries.fr: Ce que je vais te dire est un vrai secret.

entries.english: When you become really strong,
You better write this down so you don't forget.
entries.fr: Note bien ceci pour ne pas l'oublier.

entries.english: I finally wrote a song!
The saddened canary won't utter a peep.
entries.fr: Le canari triste ne chante plus.

entries.english: The monkey can sing,
Though ghosts will play out on its keys sometimes.
entries.fr: Mais parfois, des fantômes jouent sur ses touches.

entries.english: Desert cactus so alone,
The dragon sleeps,
EVE's last song has no refrain.
Then ask Queen Mary to sing along.
entries.fr: Puis demande à Mary de chanter.

entries.english: I heard that my brother died with honor in combat.
entries.fr: Mon frère est mort avec honneur au combat.

entries.english: With all our love, we held a funeral for him, and he was buried in our cemetery.
entries.fr: Nous lui avons fait des adieux pleins d'amour et l'avons enterré au cimetière.

entries.english: I am the mysterious Goods-Keeper.
You shouldn't store that.
You can't carry anything else!
entries.fr: Tu ne peux plus rien porter!

entries.english: We paid to see a trio!
Are you the guys who've been messin' with my buddies?
entries.fr: C'est vous qui avez embêté mes potes?

entries.english: You're goin' down!
I know it was you!
Who's the boss?
Let's call it a draw, okay?
I want to avenge my parents.
Don't try to make me mad.
Please!
I really don't want to butt in now, but...
entries.fr: Je ne veux pas m'en mêler, mais...

entries.english: What are you waiting for!??
You're not so good at fighting, are you?
entries.fr: Tu ne te bats pas très bien, hein?

entries.english: Rest here for a while and take it easy.
This elevator goes nowhere.
I've got tickets to the Live Show.
entries.fr: J'ai des billets pour le concert.

entries.english: You know the store is all sold out.
entries.fr: La boutique n'a plus de billets.

entries.english: You're lucky. They're all sold out at the store.
entries.fr: Tu as de la chance. La boutique n'en a plus.

entries.english: You wrecked my tank.
(Weep, weep)
You'd better pay to have it fixed!
Check back again with me later...
I just may get a really awesome weapon or two.
entries.fr: Je pourrais trouver des armes incroyables.

entries.english: You don't have enough money.
It's only a rumor, though.
